posts.title: Rethinking My AI Usage
posts.description: I was listening to a Vaush clip yesterday, and something he said must have resonated with me. He spoke about how our overreliance on AI to do the thinking for us ultimately gives us a kind of "limp." He compared it to an able-bodied person who relies on assistive technologies they don't really need, which, paradoxically, kind of cripples their ability to be able-bodied. posts.title: Long Time no See
posts.description: Hi! It's been 5 months since my last entry. I've been busy. Since then... At the end of July, my employer suddenly eliminated my position. They asked me to come into a meeting, and told me I had three days to get my stuff and get on my way. It was sudden, yet in a strange kind of way, relieving.
